agent_schedules_cron_shape_check.name: agent_schedules_cron_shape_check
agent_schedules_cron_shape_check.value: ("agent_schedules"."trigger_type" <> 'cron') OR ("agent_schedules"."cron_expr" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_schedules"."timezone" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_schedules"."next_fire_at" IS NOT NULL)

domain_events_m43_cutover_task_occurred_.name: domain_events_m43_cutover_task_occurred_idx
domain_events_m43_cutover_task_occurred_.where: "domain_events"."kind" = 'run.failed' AND "domain_events"."payload"->>'reason' = 'legacy_steps_engine_3_cutover' AND "domain_events"."payload"->>'source' = 'upgrade_cutover' AND "domain_events"."task_id" IS NOT NULL

evaluation_criterion_results_score_state.name: evaluation_criterion_results_score_state_check
evaluation_criterion_results_score_state.value: ("evaluation_criterion_results"."state" = 'scored' and "evaluation_criterion_results"."score" is not null) or ("evaluation_criterion_results"."state" <> 'scored' and "evaluation_criterion_results"."score" is null)

evaluation_participants_live_run_uq.name: evaluation_participants_live_run_uq
evaluation_participants_live_run_uq.where: "evaluation_participants"."run_id" is not null and "evaluation_participants"."removed_at" is null

evaluation_participants_observed_no_reci.name: evaluation_participants_observed_no_recipe_check
evaluation_participants_observed_no_reci.value: ("evaluation_participants"."source_type" = 'launched') or ("evaluation_participants"."recipe_id" is null and "evaluation_participants"."launch_reason" is null and "evaluation_participants"."replicate_ordinal" is null)

gate_chat_turns_pending_lease_check.name: gate_chat_turns_pending_lease_check
gate_chat_turns_pending_lease_check.value: ("gate_chat_turns"."state" = 'pending' and "gate_chat_turns"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "gate_chat_turns"."completed_at" is null and "gate_chat_turns"."error_code" is null) or ("gate_chat_turns"."state" <> 'pending' and "gate_chat_turns"."lease_expires_at" is null)

gate_chat_turns_terminal_state_check.name: gate_chat_turns_terminal_state_check
gate_chat_turns_terminal_state_check.value: ("gate_chat_turns"."state" = 'pending' and "gate_chat_turns"."agent_message_id" is null) or ("gate_chat_turns"."state" = 'completed' and "gate_chat_turns"."agent_message_id" is not null and "gate_chat_turns"."completed_at" is not null and "gate_chat_turns"."error_code" is null) or ("gate_chat_turns"."state" in ('failed', 'aborted') and "gate_chat_turns"."agent_message_id" is null and "gate_chat_turns"."completed_at" is not null and "gate_chat_turns"."error_code" is not null)

hitl_requests_agent_question_active_idx.name: hitl_requests_agent_question_active_idx
hitl_requests_agent_question_active_idx.where: "hitl_requests"."kind" = 'agent_question' AND "hitl_requests"."activation_state" = 'active' AND "hitl_requests"."responded_at" IS NULL AND "hitl_requests"."superseded_at" IS NULL

hitl_requests_decision_request_shape_che.name: hitl_requests_decision_request_shape_check
hitl_requests_decision_request_shape_che.value:
(
        "hitl_requests"."kind" = 'decision_request'
        AND "hitl_requests"."parent_hitl_request_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."source_artifact_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."decision_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."schema" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "hitl_requests"."kind" <> 'decision_request'
        AND "hitl_requests"."parent_hitl_request_id" IS NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."source_artifact_id" IS NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."decision_id" IS NULL
      )

hitl_requests_agent_question_shape_check.name: hitl_requests_agent_question_shape_check
hitl_requests_agent_question_shape_check.value:
(
        "hitl_requests"."kind" = 'agent_question'
        AND "hitl_requests"."task_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."activation_state" IS NOT NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."retrigger_mode" IS NOT NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."schema" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "hitl_requests"."kind" <> 'agent_question'
        AND "hitl_requests"."task_id" IS NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."activation_state" IS NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."retrigger_mode" IS NULL
      )

hitl_requests_agent_question_supersessio.name: hitl_requests_agent_question_supersession_check
hitl_requests_agent_question_supersessio.value:
(
        "hitl_requests"."kind" <> 'agent_question'
        AND "hitl_requests"."superseded_at" IS NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."superseded_by_hitl_request_id" IS NULL
        AND "hitl_requests"."superseded_by_run_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "hitl_requests"."kind" = 'agent_question'
        AND (
          (
            "hitl_requests"."superseded_at" IS NULL
            AND "hitl_requests"."superseded_by_hitl_request_id" IS NULL
            AND "hitl_requests"."superseded_by_run_id" IS NULL
          ) OR (
            "hitl_requests"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND (
              ("hitl_requests"."superseded_by_hitl_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "hitl_requests"."superseded_by_run_id" IS NULL)
              OR ("hitl_requests"."superseded_by_hitl_request_id" IS NULL AND "hitl_requests"."superseded_by_run_id" IS NOT NULL)
            )
          )
        )
      )

project_tokens_agent_project_check.name: project_tokens_agent_project_check
project_tokens_agent_project_check.value: "project_tokens"."token_kind" != 'agent' OR ("project_tokens"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "project_tokens"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL)

review_comments_anchor_root_check.name: review_comments_anchor_root_check
review_comments_anchor_root_check.value: ("review_comments"."parent_id" is null and "review_comments"."file_path" is not null and "review_comments"."side" is not null and "review_comments"."line" is not null and "review_comments"."line_content" is not null) or ("review_comments"."parent_id" is not null and "review_comments"."file_path" is null and "review_comments"."side" is null and "review_comments"."line" is null and "review_comments"."line_content" is null)

scratch_runs_owner_xor_check.name: scratch_runs_owner_xor_check
scratch_runs_owner_xor_check.value: ("scratch_runs"."project_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("scratch_runs"."local_package_id" IS NOT NULL)

task_clarifications_answered_context_idx.name: task_clarifications_answered_context_idx
task_clarifications_answered_context_idx.where: "task_clarifications"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL AND "task_clarifications"."superseded_at" IS NULL

task_clarifications_answer_shape_check.name: task_clarifications_answer_shape_check
task_clarifications_answer_shape_check.value:
(
        "task_clarifications"."answered_at" IS NULL
        AND "task_clarifications"."answer" IS NULL
        AND "task_clarifications"."answered_by_user_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "task_clarifications"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "task_clarifications"."answer" IS NOT NULL
        AND "task_clarifications"."answered_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

task_clarifications_supersession_check.name: task_clarifications_supersession_check
task_clarifications_supersession_check.value:
(
        "task_clarifications"."superseded_at" IS NULL
        AND "task_clarifications"."superseded_by_hitl_request_id" IS NULL
        AND "task_clarifications"."superseded_by_run_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "task_clarifications"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          ("task_clarifications"."superseded_by_hitl_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "task_clarifications"."superseded_by_run_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("task_clarifications"."superseded_by_hitl_request_id" IS NULL AND "task_clarifications"."superseded_by_run_id" IS NOT NULL)
        )
      )
